sources.title: Visual Question Answering - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Visual Question Answering (VQA) is the task of answering open-ended questions based on an image. The input to models supporting this task is typically a combination of an image and a question, and the output is an answer expressed in natural language. sources.title: VQA: Visual Question Answering
sources.snippet: VQA is a new dataset containing open-ended questions about images. These questions require an understanding of vision, language and commonsense knowledge to answer.
